items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: The band we had must have had about... Joseph Phillip... and myself... that's 11... Oh man, they had about 18 pieces.

ctx.x: What about guitar players? Did they have any guitar players out there?
In church? Oh yeah, they had them and a boy named Joseph Phillip. Boy, he could pick a guitar. My God. I never heard nobody play a guitar like him.
I wonder what ever happened to him.
